reasons.correctness: PUT /{categoryId}/order returns 204. reorderCategory rejects missing, extra, duplicate and null ids with error.business.faq_reorder_mismatch, sets displayOrder i+1, saves each FAQ and keeps ResourceNotFoundException. Build green, 6/6 acceptance tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: The endpoint has @PreAuthorize ADMIN and inherits the class-level @RateLimit. BusinessRuleTranslatableException is used; both keys are in en and pl. Injection is by explicit constructor, the body is a *DtoIn, and the MockitoExtension unit test was run.
reasons.design_fit: Logic sits in FaqService and reuses BaseService save() and findByCategoryAndActiveTrue. FaqCategoryController now also depends on FaqService, a second service dependency; FaqCategoryService could own the delegation. Footprint is otherwise minimal.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest has 7 tests: reorder, any order, missing, foreign and duplicate ids, null list, unknown category. Tests never verify save() is called. Strictness.LENIENT and an unneeded SecurityContext setup weaken them.
reasons.graph_use: One initial graph query listed the faq package files, and the reads followed it. The exception type, message keys and unit-test examples (CityServiceUnitTest, AddressServiceUnitTest) were found by grep and glob, not the graph.
